items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Naturally I was hanging out with Mr. Billy Gladstone and the people at Radio City

ctx.x: Yes. Like I started on trumpet and how I wound up. I don't know what I'm doing. I have to ask all of these peoples; but my knowledge of the musical instruments and with my experience - and when I say my experience I'm not speaking Jo Jones first-person singular. I'm speaking Jo Jones fifth-person plurally. All these peoples we realize - I remember at the time. Now the greatest all around drummer that I remember as a conductor and everything was a fellow by the name of Sylvester Rice. I have never seen nobody with…
Who did he play with, Jo?
